note: Official trophy names, descriptions and grades as published on PlayStation, reported 18 Nov 2026 by Exophase and cross-checked with PSNProfiles and TrueAchievements (see planetgta6.com). All 55 trophies are offline; 28 are hidden on PlayStation until earned. Guides are this entry's own words; each cites its sources.

trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.guide: The platinum pops on its own the moment the other 54 trophies are done — there is nothing extra to do for it. In practice the last one you earn is usually A Long Road (100% completion) or one of the long grinds such as the 250 stunts, so plan the run around those. Sources: official list (Exophase / PSNProfiles); roadmap overview in the KeenGamer guide.

trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
trophies.guide: Finish the opening mission, Gone Fishing. It is the first mission of the game, so this unlocks naturally in your first session — no choices or side objectives affect it. Sources: official list; KeenGamer trophy table.

trophies.name: Paradise Lost
trophies.guide: Play the story in order and finish Chapter 1; the trophy pops at the chapter's final mission. Before you leave Chapter 1, do the balcony meditation for Positive Mental Attitude (see that trophy) — it is the one thing in this chapter that can be missed. Sources: official list; KeenGamer roadmap step 1.

trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money
trophies.guide: Complete Chapter 2 by playing through its missions in order. Nothing in this chapter can lock you out of a trophy — the only missable flag in the whole list sits in Chapter 1. Sources: official list; KeenGamer trophy table.

trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!
trophies.guide: Complete Chapter 3. Keep a manual save at the start of the chapter: there is no mission replay in GTA 6, so separate saves are your only way back if you want to revisit an earlier section. Sources: official list; KeenGamer roadmap (no mission replay, 15 manual save slots).

trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma
trophies.guide: Complete Chapter 4. The optional mission That's Where The Money Is… unlocks the eight large bank vaults during this chapter — run it when it appears, since those vaults feed both Maximum Withdrawal and 100% completion. Sources: official list; KeenGamer 100% completion section.

trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
trophies.guide: Complete the final story mission. This is the finale of the campaign — finish it and the gold pops. Free roam stays open afterwards, so nothing in the open world is cut off by finishing the story. Sources: official list; KeenGamer roadmap (free roam after story: yes).

trophies.name: Trust
trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Breakfast Run. It unlocks as part of the campaign — just keep playing the main missions in order and it will come up. Sources: official list; KeenGamer trophy table.

trophies.name: Break the Bank
trophies.guide: Complete the story mission The Cartel Heist. Heist missions are story beats, so this one arrives on its own as you work through the chapters. Sources: official list; KeenGamer trophy table.

trophies.name: Family Matters
trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Child's Play. Story mission trophies like this one cannot be missed — they unlock the moment the mission's end screen appears. Sources: official list; KeenGamer trophy table.

trophies.name: DWNFALL
trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Headliners. Keep playing the main story and it unlocks in sequence; there are no optional objectives tied to it. Sources: official list; KeenGamer trophy table.

trophies.name: Hi-Jacked
trophies.guide: Complete the story mission VCIA Takedown, set around Vice City International Airport. It is a campaign mission, so it comes up naturally as the story reaches the airport. Sources: official list; KeenGamer trophy table.

trophies.name: Snow Storm
trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Operation Savage Glory. Like every chapter and mission trophy, it is unmissable — finish the mission and it pops. Sources: official list; KeenGamer trophy table.

trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.guide: Reach 100% completion. Open Progress > Stats > 100% Completion in game to see what is left — you only need the listed portions, not everything in the game. The big numbers (KeenGamer): 100 optional tasks, 39 gang operations, 22 bank jobs, 7 payday loan jobs, 8 bank vaults, 15 of 18 card sets, 100 WAiNK scans, 33 underwater discoveries, 42 of 42 shooting range gold medals, 300 of 397 stunts, 70 of 80 challenges and 15 of 15 of Bret's target decks. Do it after the story, when free roam is fully open. Sources: official list; KeenGamer 100% completion section.

trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
trophies.guide: Complete 250 stunts — jumps, near-misses and trick moves while driving count, but only unique stunts add to the total, so vary what you do instead of repeating one jump. The 100% checklist counts 300 of 397 stunts, so this silver pops on the way to A Long Road. Sources: official list; KeenGamer (250 unique stunts; 300 of 397 for 100%).

trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Try each of the nine activity types once — one attempt each is enough, no wins or medals needed. KeenGamer counts nine types: the game's races, shooting range, fishing, arcade games, bowling, pool, mini golf, basketball and drone races cover the list, so sample one of each early and this pops fast. Sources: official list; KeenGamer (nine activity types).

trophies.name: The Shootist
trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Earn a gold medal in all 42 Shooting Range challenges. Every challenge has a gold score threshold; repeat one until the gold clears, then move on. All 42 golds are also required for 100% completion, so there is no shortcut — practise the weapon types you are weakest at first. Sources: official list; KeenGamer (42 shooting range gold medals).

trophies.name: Top Fun
trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun drone race at all 14 locations. One win per location is enough. The 42 drone time trials across the same 14 spots also count toward 100% completion, so the flying practice pays off twice — learn each course's line while racing, then mop up the time trials. Sources: official list; KeenGamer (14 locations; 42 drone time trials).

trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
trophies.guide: Win 20 different races — repeats of the same race do not count, so keep entering new events. The 100% checklist wants 30 of 40 races won, so this bronze pops on the way there. Sources: official list; KeenGamer (30 of 40 races for 100%).

trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge. Fishing is introduced early in the game; challenge Cal, land the bigger catch, and the trophy pops. If the first attempt fails, challenge him again — fishing challenges can be retried. Sources: official list; KeenGamer trophy table.

trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
trophies.guide: Complete any one arcade game — play a cabinet game through to its end. Any machine counts, so pick the first one you find and finish a full run. Sources: official list; KeenGamer trophy table.

trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission of Andy's stranger mission strand. Stranger strands appear as icons across Leonida — keep returning to Andy as new missions unlock, and the strand ends with a final mission that pops this trophy. Sources: official list; KeenGamer roadmap step 3.

trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission of Kenton's stranger strand. Kenton also ties into the treasure sets — 5 of his 7 sets count toward 100% completion — so hunt his collectibles while you work through his missions. Sources: official list; KeenGamer 100% completion section.

trophies.name: The Lone Rider
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission of Billy's stranger strand. Like the other stranger finals, it unlocks by returning to Billy whenever a new mission in his strand appears on the map. Sources: official list; KeenGamer roadmap step 3.

trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Complete 8 stranger mission strands across Leonida. There are more strands than eight, so pick the ones you enjoy — each strand ends in a final mission, and five of those finals have their own trophies (Andy, Kenton, Billy, Randy, Tyrone). Sources: official list; KeenGamer roadmap step 3.

trophies.name: Supply & Demand
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission of Randy's stranger strand. Keep checking back with Randy as his strand progresses — stranger missions unlock over the course of the story and into free roam. Sources: official list; KeenGamer roadmap step 3.

trophies.name: Spin On This!
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission of Tyrone's stranger strand. Tyrone is the last of the five named stranger finals, so finishing his strand also moves you toward the eight strands needed for Strangers & Freaks. Sources: official list; KeenGamer roadmap step 3.

trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: Meditate at all 18 meditation spots across Leonida. THE one to protect: in Chapter 1, after the mission Down to Earth, find Lucia at Jason's house in the morning — she mentions meditating, follow her to the balcony and accept her invitation. KeenGamer flags this balcony meditation as the only currently identified potentially missable interaction, and there is no mission replay, so keep a manual save before it. 100% completion only needs 15 of 18 spots, but this trophy needs all 18. Sources: official list; KeenGamer roadmap step 1 and 100% section.

trophies.name: Fair Game
trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Hunt a unique animal for Bret as part of his hunting strand. Use binoculars to study animals — the 100% checklist also wants 100 species studied and all 15 of Bret's Target Decks finished, so the hunting practice overlaps with the completion grind. Sources: official list; KeenGamer 100% completion section.

trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck
trophies.guide: Complete 3 full collectible card sets. Cards are scattered across Leonida in shops, stashes and mission rewards; 100% completion needs 15 of 18 sets, so this silver pops early in the card hunt. Track sets in the collection menu and finish the nearly-complete ones first. Sources: official list; KeenGamer (15 of 18 card sets for 100%).

trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
trophies.guide: Use the WAiNK app to scan 100 different locations. Scan everything unfamiliar as you travel — vehicles and landmarks both register — and this climbs on its own. 100% completion wants 100 WAiNK scans and 200 of 277 base-model vehicles discovered, so scanning early saves hours of cleanup. Sources: official list; KeenGamer roadmap step 1 and 100% section.

trophies.name: One Last Thing
trophies.guide: Complete 50 Challenges. Challenges cover all kinds of feats — driving, combat, exploration — and the counter adds up across every type, so pick the easy ones first. 100% completion wants 70 of 80, so keep going past 50. Sources: official list; KeenGamer (70 of 80 challenges for 100%).

trophies.name: Hot Together
trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: With your partner beside you, build a 4-star wanted level, then break line of sight and escape until the stars clear. Stay together until the heat is fully gone — if your partner is left behind or caught, the attempt fails. Use the countryside or water to break pursuit. Sources: official list; KeenGamer trophy table.

trophies.name: Retail Therapy
trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: With your partner, rob three shops in a row while keeping at least one wanted star the whole time — if the wanted level clears between robberies, the chain breaks. Plan a short route between three nearby shops, hit them fast, and keep moving so the police stay on you. Sources: official list; KeenGamer trophy table.

trophies.name: Whip It Good
trophies.guide: Discover 100 different vehicles — the WAiNK app scan is how discoveries register, so scan every new car, bike, boat and aircraft you come across. 100% completion asks for 200 of 277 base models, so keep scanning from the start. Sources: official list; KeenGamer (200 of 277 base-model vehicles for 100%).

trophies.name: Gunslinger
trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Activate Combat Focus — the slow-motion aiming mode — and take down five enemies before it ends. Pick a busy firefight, wait until enemies cluster in the open, then trigger it and work through them quickly. Sources: official list; KeenGamer trophy table.

trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Make an unscheduled departure at Vice City International Airport: steal a departing passenger aircraft and take off with it. KeenGamer's reading is to board a plane that is about to leave and fly it out — expect airport security, so come prepared and take off as soon as you are aboard. Sources: official list; KeenGamer trophy table.

trophies.name: Challenging Tank
trophies.guide: Steal a Rhino military tank and use it in combat. Expect heavy resistance at the military site — bring armour and a fast escape plan for after you grab it, and use the tank's cannon once you are rolling to make sure the combat use registers. Sources: official list; KeenGamer trophy table.

trophies.name: Sneakthief
trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Rob a jewelry store without being detected — go in quiet, stay out of cameras' and guards' sightlines, grab the goods and leave before any alarm. If anyone spots you, the attempt fails, so leave and retry rather than fighting through it. Sources: official list; KeenGamer trophy table.

trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
trophies.guide: Rob 5 bank vaults and escape. Eight vaults exist and all eight count toward 100% completion; the large vaults unlock with the optional mission That's Where The Money Is… in Chapter 4, so run that mission first, then work through the vaults with a getaway vehicle ready. Sources: official list; KeenGamer 100% completion section.

trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Rob an armored truck and escape. Trucks run set routes around the state — ambush one away from heavy police patrols, crack it open, grab the cash and break away before the wanted level builds. Sources: official list; KeenGamer trophy table.

trophies.name: The Goodtime State
trophies.guide: Explore all of Leonida and uncover the complete map. Drive, fly and sail into every region until no fog remains — the islands, swamps and backroads all count. WAiNK scans along the way feed your location and vehicle totals for other trophies. Sources: official list; KeenGamer trophy table.

trophies.name: Pest Control
trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob at least one Illegal Operation belonging to each of the nine gangs. Gang operations are marked as you discover them; 100% completion wants all 39 operations, so this bronze pops early in that grind. Sources: official list; KeenGamer (nine gangs; 39 gang operations for 100%).

trophies.name: In The Beginning…
trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach. The exact trigger is still unconfirmed — KeenGamer lists it as unconfirmed — so try the beachfront bars at sunset and watch for a drink prompt with the ocean in view. This guide will be updated once players confirm the method. Sources: official list; KeenGamer trophy table (exact trigger still being confirmed).

trophies.name: Capital Offense
trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style — drive a car through the showroom glass. KeenGamer lists the exact method as still unconfirmed, so try the most direct route: in through the front, out through the window, at speed. Sources: official list; KeenGamer trophy table (exact method still unconfirmed).

trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling
trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Steal the three key valuables at Kolt & Associates' bowling alley and escape, as KeenGamer reports. Go in quiet, take all three valuables, and leave before security locks the place down. Sources: official list; KeenGamer trophy table.

trophies.name: Personal Best
trophies.guide: Maximise the Strength stat for both Jason and Lucia — KeenGamer reports this as the requirement behind the vague description. Gym workouts and physical activities raise Strength, so train both characters evenly rather than maxing one first. Sources: official list; KeenGamer trophy table.

trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
trophies.guide: Perform 500 actions that affect your Criminal Profile — robberies, stick-ups and other crimes all feed the counter, per KeenGamer. It climbs naturally across a full playthrough, so keep playing the criminal side of the game and it will pop in the endgame. Sources: official list; KeenGamer trophy table.

trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
trophies.guide: Hidden trophy with an unconfirmed unlock method — KeenGamer lists it as unconfirmed, and the name hints that a second attempt succeeds where the first failed. Nothing reliable is known yet: keep playing and it will surface as players confirm it, and this guide will be updated when the method is confirmed. Sources: official list; KeenGamer trophy table (unconfirmed).

trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
trophies.guide: Hidden trophy with an unconfirmed unlock method — KeenGamer lists it as unconfirmed. The description suggests a strange or secret encounter somewhere in Leonida. Avoid guides claiming a sure method until players confirm one; this guide will be updated when it is confirmed. Sources: official list; KeenGamer trophy table (unconfirmed).

trophies.name: Ten Pin
trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by — strike someone with a melee weapon from a moving vehicle. KeenGamer notes the precise method is still being confirmed: slow down beside a pedestrian, swing from the driver's seat, and repeat until it registers. Sources: official list; KeenGamer trophy table (precise method still being confirmed).

trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Launder a cumulative $250,000 in Marked Bills through your contacts. Marked bills come from robberies — fence them steadily through the contacts the game introduces, and the total also feeds 100% completion, which wants exactly $250,000 of marked bills fenced. Sources: official list; KeenGamer 100% completion section.

trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 across all shops — weapons, clothes, food and gear all count toward the total. Big purchases push it along fast, so buy the gear you actually want instead of grinding small items. Sources: official list; KeenGamer trophy table.

trophies.name: Little Boxes
trophies.guide: Purchase all eight purchasable garage properties. KeenGamer counts eight garages. Save up during the story — garages also store the vehicles you register for On the Spot, so buy them before you start registering cars. Sources: official list; KeenGamer (all eight purchasable garage properties).

trophies.name: On the Spot
trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register 10 vehicles through the Scooter Bros app — drive a vehicle you own, open the app and register it. Ten different vehicles are needed, so use the garages from Little Boxes to keep the ones you want. Sources: official list; KeenGamer trophy table.
